name: Otaku
description: Discover anime via AniList AND track your own — favorites, watch status, episode counts. Search by title, browse by genre, see what's trending, find similar shows, and keep a per-server list of what you've watched.
author: CubCadetXT1

slash_commands.name: anime
slash_commands.description: Search AniList for an anime by name.

options.name: genre
options.description: Genre to browse (e.g. Action, Romance, Sci-Fi)

slash_commands.name: trending
slash_commands.description: Show the top trending anime this season.

slash_commands.name: similar
slash_commands.description: Show anime similar to one you've looked up.

options.name: anime
options.description: Anime to find recommendations for (defaults to your last /anime lookup)

slash_commands.name: random
slash_commands.description: Roll a single random anime, optionally filtered by genre.

slash_commands.name: character
slash_commands.description: Look up an AniList character by name.

slash_commands.name: help
slash_commands.description: List every otaku command with a one-line description.

slash_commands.name: favorite
slash_commands.description: Mark your last /anime lookup (or a passed title) as a favorite.

options.name: anime
options.description: Anime to favorite (defaults to your last /anime lookup)

options.name: user
options.description: Whose favorites to show (defaults to you)

slash_commands.name: watch
slash_commands.description: Set watch status for your last /anime lookup.

slash_commands.name: rate
slash_commands.description: Rate your last /anime lookup on a 1.0–10.0 scale (half-points OK).

options.name: score
options.description: Score from 1.0 to 10.0 (half-points like 7.5 are allowed)

slash_commands.name: ratings
slash_commands.description: Show a user's rated anime, sorted by score.

options.name: user
options.description: Whose ratings to show (defaults to you)

slash_commands.name: progress
slash_commands.description: Record episodes watched for your last /anime lookup.

slash_commands.name: import
slash_commands.description: Import an AniList user's anime list into your tracker.

slash_commands.name: stats
slash_commands.description: Show a user's aggregate anime stats — counts, mean score, hours, top genre.

options.name: user
options.description: Whose stats to show (defaults to you)

slash_commands.name: list
slash_commands.description: List a user's tracked anime, paginated and optionally filtered by status.

options.name: user
options.description: Whose list to show (defaults to you)
